result:
Three merged PRs since 2026-04-14 added or removed a line containing `ThreadLocal` under `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api`. I used the head of `master` (`5eb8cba2`, 2026-10-13) as the pinned head.

1. **#6672**, merged 2026-10-13 (`0340ada6`). It moved the `userContextHolder` `ThreadLocal` declaration above the `log` field in `Context.java` so the holder initializes before the logger. The `+` side of the diff contains the `ThreadLocal` line. @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/context/Context.java:153-165}
2. **#6544**, merged 2026-10-08 (`a69b14a8`). In `Context.java`, it removed the `Object[]`-wrapped `ThreadLocal` and its "avoid ThreadLocal bug in Java 1.5" comment, and added `ThreadLocal<UserContext> userContextHolder`. The Javadoc also gained a `{@link ThreadLocal}` reference. @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/context/Context.java:145-160}
3. **#6588**, merged 2026-09-21 (`f10e3fb9`). It added the `UserPasswordGuard.DEPTH` `ThreadLocal<Integer>` in `UserServiceImpl.java`. The commit title calls it a thread-local guard in UserDAO, but the code is in the service. @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/UserServiceImpl.java:111}

Commits that touched the same files but did not change a `ThreadLocal` line:
- #6349 (`b68355b3`, 2026-07-21) removed the `StackWalker` checks from `Daemon.java`. The `ThreadLocal` lines there are unchanged context.
- The other `Daemon.java` commits (#6483, #6383, #6627 and the `265582974` comment cleanup) and the `Context.java` commits (`83411b2f`, `c4aca3af`, `1b5421a9`, `84963803`) also left `ThreadLocal` lines unchanged.
- The `UserServiceImpl.java` commits `cb6cda42`, `a69b14a8`, `2c9b2ee0` and `1b5421a9` did not change one either.

Current `ThreadLocal` declarations under the path (for reference): `Daemon.java:50,52`, `Context.java:162`, `UserServiceImpl.java:111`, `ImmutableEntityInterceptor.java:41`.

Limits:
- I checked every in-window commit that touched the four files that contain `ThreadLocal` at HEAD, plus `Daemon.java` and `Context.java`. I did not check commits to other files under the path. So a `ThreadLocal` line removed entirely from a file that no longer has one would not appear here.
- Falkon's grep on the parent commit returned nothing, so I compared diffs per commit instead. The large diff dump was saved to a file that I was not permitted to read.
- Dates are the commit dates from `list_commits`, which I took as the merge dates.
